text: **Concrete roads** are extremely common in the Philippines.
NOTE: Thailand also has a lot of concrete roads.
text_zh: 菲律賓非常常見 **混凝土路面**。
注意：泰國也有許多混凝土路面。

text: The Philippines drives on the **right**.
NOTE: Within Southeast Asia, Cambodia, Laos, Taiwan and Vietnam also drive on the right.
text_zh: 菲律賓靠 **右** 行駛。
注意：在東南亞中，柬埔寨、寮國、台灣和越南也是靠右行駛。

text: Standard white licence plates with black text are used for passenger vehicles. You can also find many older plates from the 2002 series, which are recognisable due to their **green tint**.
text_zh: 載客車輛使用標準白底黑字的車牌。你也可以找到許多 2002 年系列的舊車牌，其特徵是帶有 **綠色色調**。

text: **Octagonal metal poles** are quite common in the Philippines.
NOTE: They can sometimes be found in [Bangladesh](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LAQNfYnDxvMB8vTbA) and [some parts of Malaysia](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jCzCnTXETaJUq5Af9) as well.
text_zh: 菲律賓相當常見 **八角形金屬電桿**。
注意：這些電桿有時也可以在 [孟加拉](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LAQNfYnDxvMB8vTbA) 和 [馬來西亞部分地區](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jCzCnTXETaJUq5Af9) 找到。

text: You will often see a single insulator at the top of a vertical bar which is attached to the side of a utility pole.
text_zh: 你常會在附著於電線桿側邊的垂直桿子頂端看到單一絕緣子。

text: Middle road lines in the Philippines can be either yellow or white. In particular, you will often see combined **yellow and white** middle lines, which is not common in any other East Asian country.
Yellow road lines commonly have a distinct [**orange tint**](https://goo.gl/maps/vT9Mpun12cRGEgun7).
text_zh: 菲律賓的中央道路標線可以是黃色或白色。特別的是，你常會看到 **黃白** 混合的中央標線，這在其他東亞國家並不常見。
黃色道路標線通常帶有明顯的 [**橘色色調**](https://goo.gl/maps/vT9Mpun12cRGEgun7)。

text: These tall, square **yellow road stones** are unique to the Philippines.
text_zh: 這些高大的方形 **黃色道路界石** 是菲律賓特有的。

text: Chevrons are typically **red on white**.
text_zh: 轉彎標誌通常是 **紅底白字**。

text: Sign posts are often painted **red**, **orange** or **yellow**.
text_zh: 標誌支柱經常漆成 **紅色**、**橘色** 或 **黃色**。

text: **Tuk-tuks**, also referred to as tricycles, are extremely common in the Philippines, in many areas they are more common than typical cars.
text_zh: **嘟嘟車**（又稱為三輪車）在菲律賓極為常見，在許多地區甚至比一般汽車更常見。

text: Although Filipino is the official language of the Philippines, **English** is extremely common to find on signs. It is the only major Southeast Asian country where you’re likely to come across English.
text_zh: 雖然菲律賓語是菲律賓的官方語言，但標誌上出現 **英文** 的情況非常普遍。這是你可能會遇到英文的主要東南亞國家中唯一的一個。

text: In Generation 3 you can come across a white Street View car with the **black roof** clearly visible.
You may also come across a silvery grey car, which is also found in [Bhutan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WWXr2nyNkq8i9Gna8).
text_zh: 在第三代相機中，你會遇到一台白色 Google 車，且 **黑色車頂** 清晰可見。
你可能也會遇到銀灰色汽車，這款車也會出現在 [不丹](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WWXr2nyNkq8i9Gna8)。

text: It is somewhat common to see grains being spread out on roads to dry.
NOTE: This practice is also common in Vietnam.
text_zh: 在道路上鋪開穀物晾乾的情況相當常見。
注意：這種做法在越南也很常見。

text: These black or white boxes are commonly seen on utility poles. Most of the time they feature a three letter abbreviation of the municipality you are in. The abbreviations will either have all three letters stand for the municipality, or the first two letters will abbreviate the municipality while the third letter indicates the province.
In the first image the "GMI" and "GMU" stands for the town of Gamu in the province of Isabela while the second image the "BGE" stands for the town of Bangued.
NOTE: Most towns do not have any standardised abbreviation so you might find many different abbreviations for the same place.
text_zh: 這些黑色或白色箱子經常出現在電線桿上。大多數時候，它們上面會有你所在自治市的三個字母縮寫。這些縮寫要嘛全部三個字母都代表自治市，要嘛前兩個字母代表自治市，而第三個字母代表省份。
在第一張圖片中，「GMI」和「GMU」代表伊莎貝拉省的加姆鎮（Gamu），而在第二張圖片中，「BGE」代表班格德鎮（Bangued）。
注意：大多數城鎮沒有標準化的縮寫，因此你可能會在同一個地方發現許多不同的縮寫。

text: The Philippines have several different tuk-tuk and tricycle designs, roughly distributed as shown in this infographic.
_This image was provided by AeroGelo. You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 菲律賓有多種不同的嘟嘟車和三輪車設計，大約分佈如這張資訊圖所示。
_這張圖片由 AeroGelo 提供。你可以點擊圖片以放大。_

text: **Province names** are very common to find on signs and can thus be very useful. However, they do not appear on the map, meaning they’re necessary to memorise in order to use them.
It is worth mentioning that Davao de Oro changed its name from Compostela Valley in 2019.
text_zh: **省份名稱**在標誌上非常常見，因此非常有用。然而，它們不會出現在地圖上，這意味著必須背下來才能使用它們。
值得一提的是，Davao de Oro 於 2019 年從 Compostela Valley 更名。

text: Landlines will start with a 0 followed by the **area code**. Mobile phone numbers start with 09.
text_zh: 市話以 0 開頭，後面接著**區域號碼**。手機號碼則是以 09 開頭。

text: Motorcycles in the Philippines have regional colour-coded plates as seen on this map. Notably, the northern half of the country has the coloured strip at the top, while the southern half has it on the bottom of the plate.
text_zh: 菲律賓的機車擁有如這張地圖所示的全區彩色車牌。值得注意的是，該國北部半部的車牌彩色條紋在上方，而南部半部則在車牌下方。

text: The forested mountain range in Northern Luzon is characterised by somewhat **dry mountainsides** and an abundance of **pine trees**. You may rarely come across a similar landscape on high-altitude roads in [Mindanao](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dowDy4SWZt1pvxtG9).
text_zh: 呂宋島北部的森林山脈特徵是有些**乾燥的山腰**和大量的**松樹**。你可能很少在[民答那峨](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dowDy4SWZt1pvxtG9)的高海拔道路上遇到類似的景觀。

text: While **corn** can be found in most of the country, it is most common on northern Luzon and on Mindanao.
text_zh: 雖然**玉米**在該國大部分地區都能找到，但最常見於呂宋島北部和 Mindanao。

text: The vast majority of **Oil palm** plantations are found on Mindanao.
text_zh: 絕大多數的**油棕**園都位於 Mindanao。

text: The majority of **sugarcane** in the Philippines can be found on the islands of Negros and Panay.
text_zh: 菲律賓的大多數**甘蔗**分佈在 Negros 和 Panay 島上。

text: **Pineapple **plantations are mostly found on Mindanao.
text_zh: **鳳梨**園主要分佈在 Mindanao。

text: **Banana** plantations are almost exclusively found in central and southern Mindanao.
NOTE: Wild growing banana plants can be found all over the country, so make sure what you are seeing is an actual plantation before guessing.
text_zh: **香蕉**園幾乎全數分佈在 Mindanao 的中部和南部。
注意：野生生長的香蕉樹在全國各地都能找到，所以在猜測之前，請確定你看到的是真正的農場。

text: [Moluccan albizia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falcataria_falcata) are trees with **light coloured trunks **and [**pinnate leaves**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinnation) near the top of the tree. They are mainly found on Mindanao and are especially common in the eastern and central regions of the island.
text_zh: [摩鹿加合歡](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falcataria_falcata)是樹幹**顏色較淺**且樹頂附近長有[**羽狀葉**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinnation)的樹木。它們主要分佈在民答那峨，在該島的東部和中部地區尤其常見。

text: Houses built with [amakan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amakan) walls, a traditionally woven bamboo mat, with a **diamond pattern** are almost exclusively found in the southern half of the country.
text_zh: 用[amakan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amakan)（一種傳統編織的竹蓆，帶有**菱形圖案**）牆壁建造的房屋幾乎只在該國南部地區發現。

text: Houses built with amakan walls (referred to as Sawali in the north) with a **diagonally woven pattern** are mostly found on the island of Palawan, but can also be found throughout the northern half of the country.
text_zh: 以 amakan 牆壁（在北部稱為 Sawali）且具有**斜向編織圖案**建造的房屋主要分佈在 Palawan 島上，但也散見於該國的北部半部。

text: In the Cordillera Administrative Region you can find **yellow and black** striped concrete guardrails.
text_zh: 在科迪勒拉行政區，你可以找到**黃黑**相間的混凝土護欄。

text: White guardrails with **three recurring black stripes** are unique to the region of Bicol in southern Luzon.
text_zh: 帶有**三道重複黑條紋**的白色護欄是呂宋島南部比科爾地區特有的。

text: Square concrete poles with an** indent **on both side, similar to the poles found in Chile, are mainly found north of Manila and in and around the city of Bacolod on the island of Negros.
text_zh: 兩側都有**凹槽**的正方形混凝土電線桿，類似於智利發現的電線桿，主要分佈在馬尼拉以北以及 Negros 島上的巴科洛德市內及周邊地區。

text: A poletop made up of two tall vertical metal bars having an [L-shaped cross-section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tQrN9cdrQZshGuAQ6) which are connected via several thin wires, making it resemble a ladder, is unique to Manila and the surrounding area.

NOTE: You may sometimes come across [similar looking poletops](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HSfKKMtbuvh2JS9i7), with square bars instead of L-shaped ones, throughout the entire country. They will however almost never have more than two connecting wires.
text_zh: 由兩根具有[L 型橫截面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tQrN9cdrQZshGuAQ6)的高大垂直金屬桿組成、並透過幾根細電線連接而使其看起來像梯子的電線桿頂部，是馬尼拉及周邊地區特有的。
注意：你偶爾可能會在全國各地遇到[看起來相似的電線桿頂部](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HSfKKMtbuvh2JS9i7)，它們使用的是方形桿而不是 L 型桿。然而，它們幾乎永遠不會有超過兩條連接線。

text: **Square metal mesh poles** are found on Mindanao, mainly on the Zamboanga peninsula.
NOTE: Most of the poles found outside of the Zamboanga peninsula are found along highways and have poletops with [three hanging insulators](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Tjfv9YpHyA3eSqoNA).
text_zh: **方型金屬網電線桿**分佈在 Mindanao，主要在三寶顏半島。
注意：三寶顏半島以外發現的大多數電線桿都位於公路沿線，並且其電線桿頂部帶有[三個懸掛式絕緣子](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Tjfv9YpHyA3eSqoNA)。

text: While most of the Philippines is strongly Christian, a region of western Mindanao is majority **Muslim**.
text_zh: 雖然菲律賓大部分地區篤信基督教，但西 Mindanao 的一個地區主要信仰**伊斯蘭教**。

text: Decorations made of neon-green **Mountain Dew bottles** are commonly found in the north, particularly on northern Luzon.
text_zh: 由螢光綠**山露汽水瓶**製成的裝飾品在北部很常見，特別是在呂宋島北部。

text: This type of tractor, called a [kuliglig](https://noypicollections.blogspot.com/2011/07/improvised-vehicle-in-northern-luzon.html), is mostly found on the plains around Cauayan on northern Luzon.
text_zh: 這種稱為[kuliglig](https://noypicollections.blogspot.com/2011/07/improvised-vehicle-in-northern-luzon.html)的拖拉機主要分佈在呂宋島北部考亞延（Cauayan）周邊的平原上。

text: On central Bohol you can find these distinct round grassy hills. The hills generally have [dark brown soil](https://www.google.com/maps/@9.8929167,124.09105,3a,15y,134.64h,94.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sAx3Neg240pCWv6JHjQpPDQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) beneath the grass, earning them the name of [Chocolate Hills](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chocolate_Hills).
text_zh: 在薄荷島中部，你可以找到這些獨特的圓形草山。這些山丘的草皮下方通常有[深棕色土壤](https://www.google.com/maps/@9.8929167,124.09105,3a,15y,134.64h,94.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sAx3Neg240pCWv6JHjQpPDQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)，因此贏得了[巧克力山](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chocolate_Hills)的稱號。

text: The Arayat Volcano can be recognised by being completely surrounded by flat agricultural fields.
text_zh: 阿拉亞特火山的特徵是完全被平坦的農田所包圍。

text: The Mayon Volcano is one of the tallest mountains in the Philippines and can be recognised by its almost perfect **smooth cone shape**. Beware that it will very often be covered in [clouds](https://goo.gl/maps/vVLbxF6FtgkXgyRk6).
text_zh: 馬榮火山是菲律賓最高的高山之一，其特徵是幾近完美的**平滑圓錐形**。請注意，它非常常被[雲層](https://goo.gl/maps/vVLbxF6FtgkXgyRk6)覆蓋。

text: In and around the city of Marawi, Mindanao you can find many destroyed houses and ruins from the [Marawi siege](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siege_of_Marawi) in 2017.
text_zh: 在 Mindanao 馬拉威市及其周邊地區，你可以找到許多 2017 年[馬拉威戰役](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siege_of_Marawi)中被毀的房屋和廢墟。

text: These large decorated white waystones, commemorating the [Bataan Death March](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bataan_Death_March), can be seen along roads going from [Mariveles](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BJcyas8RAYUKhYgv9) and [Bagac](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3BfLZHBPRJogywTB8) in the south to [San Fernando](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RQpRQ69K63Lxzvbf8) in the north.
NOTE: The Bataan Death March continued from San Fernando to Capas by train, where a [larger memorial](https://maps.app.goo.gl/78N5YwJE9SDQm4Gr6) has been built.
text_zh: 這些紀念[巴丹死亡行軍](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bataan_Death_March)的大型裝飾白色路標，沿著從南部的[馬里弗韋斯](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BJcyas8RAYUKhYgv9)和[巴加克](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3BfLZHBPRJogywTB8)通往北部的[聖費爾南多](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RQpRQ69K63Lxzvbf8)的道路上都可以看到。
注意：巴丹死亡行軍從聖費爾南多繼續由火車運送至卡帕斯，那裡建有[更大的紀念碑](https://maps.app.goo.gl/78N5YwJE9SDQm4Gr6)。

text: The highway going south from Puerto Princesa on Palawan can be characterised by being very wide, often featuring six lanes, while simultaneously having very little traffic.
Along the road you will usually see this [double electrical wire](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7VB1HRxdQfBNCKWG6), which can help confirm your guess.
text_zh: 從 Palawan 的普林塞薩港向南延伸的高速公路，其特徵是非常寬闊，通常有六個車道，同時車流量非常少。
沿著道路通常可以看到這條[雙層電線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7VB1HRxdQfBNCKWG6)，這有助於確認你的猜測。

text: Lamp posts on Siquijor are typically painted **yellow**, with **black stripes** at the bottom.
text_zh: 錫基霍爾島上的路燈通常漆成**黃色**，底部帶有**黑色條紋**。

text: Images and statues of ancient **Roman soldiers** can be found on the island of Marinduque.
text_zh: 古**羅馬士兵**的雕像和雕刻可以在馬林杜克島上找到。

text: You may find this **black** Street View car with a visible **roof rack** in and around the city of General Santos.
text_zh: 你可能會在桑托斯將軍城內及周邊地區找到這輛帶有明顯**車頂架**的**黑色**街景車。

text: In northwestern Bohol you can find this Street View car with **tape** on the back.
text_zh: 在薄荷島西北部，你可以找到這輛背面帶有**膠帶**的街景車。

text: An **orange** Street View car with visible side mirrors can be found on Corregidor Island.
text_zh: 一輛帶有明顯側視鏡的**橘色**街景車可以在寇雷基多島找到。

text: This vehicle with several thick **black bars** can be found just south of the Mayon Volcano.
text_zh: 這輛帶有幾根粗**黑條紋**的車輛可以在馬榮火山的正南方找到。
